Vision Government Solutions

|

WATERFORD,CT

|

Welcome

Welcome to the Waterford, CT Online Assessment Database

The Town of Waterford has contracted with Vision Government Solutions Inc. to assist with the 2026 state-mandated revaluation.

This site contains all real property assessments based on 70% of fair market value as of the date of last revaluation which was October 1, 2022. Assessed values are subject to change while we are undergoing the revaluation process. All values will be finalized in late January 2027.

The 2026 reappraisal will be based
on sales that occurred during the twelve month period between 10/01/2025 and
10/01/2026. Using the sales search tab, users can look up sale data in
order to better understand market trends in Waterford over the past year.

Please note that assessed values do not reflect any exemptions or penalties, which are applied during the grand list finalization process.

We would like to thank the residents of Waterford in advance for their cooperation during this project.

The information contained in this database is for reference purposes only. The data should not be used for official legal description or to convey property titles. All information is subject to user verification. The Town of Waterford assumes no legal responsibility for the information contained herein.

The current mill rate is 24.54

(c) 2026 Vision Government Solutions, Inc. All rights reserved.
